variant.displayName: Find Headhunter Crewmember and Help Finish the Job
variant.briefing:
You ever get a bad feeling that you just can't shake? I had sent [TargetName] to take out the some XenoThreat servers at [Location] and I'm starting think they ran into some serious trouble.

Do me a favor, huh? Go on over and see if you can figure out what happened to them and make sure that those servers are destroyed for good.

-Stows out
